title: Gaps between tiled windows on Mac (turn off Tiled windows have margins)
short_title: Gaps between tiled windows on your Mac? One switch removes them

verify.notes: Apple's Mac User Guide page 'Change window tiling settings' (macOS 27 version, read 2026-10-22) lists the switch Tiled windows have margins under System Settings, Desktop & Dock, Windows. The check is a read-only defaults read on Ben's Mac mini (macOS 27.0.1), where the switch is off and the key reads 0; nothing was changed. The key name is not in Apple's documentation, so the video presents it only as an optional check. Panely's page states a margin around the screen and a gap between windows, each from 0 to 32 points.

scenes.title: Gaps between tiled windows
scenes.sub: Space you did not ask for.
scenes.narration: When you tile two windows on a Mac, macOS leaves a gap between them and around the edge of the screen. If you would rather the windows sat flush, here is the switch.

scenes.text: macOS adds margins to tiled windows by default. A setting turns them off.
scenes.narration: This is not a bug. Since window tiling arrived, macOS adds margins to every tiled window by default. A single setting turns them off.

scenes.label: System Settings
lines: Turn off Tiled windows have margins
scenes.ui: The change applies the next time you tile a window.
scenes.narration: Open System Settings and click Desktop and Dock. Go to the Windows section, and turn off Tiled windows have margins. Tile a window again, and it fills its half of the screen with no gap.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: If you want to confirm it in Terminal, this setting reads zero when the margins are off.

scenes.name: Panely
scenes.line: Snaps windows with a shortcut or a drag, with a margin around the screen and a gap between windows, each from 0 to 32 points.
scenes.narration: Panely is a menu bar app that snaps windows with a shortcut or a drag. The macOS switch covers every margin at once. In Panely, you set the screen margin and the window gap separately, from zero to 32 points.
